sources.quote: Priced at just $0.25/1M input tokens and $1.50/1M output tokens, 3.1 Flash-Lite delivers enhanced performance at a fraction of the cost of larger models.
sources.supports: Google announced the model with $0.25 input and $1.50 output pricing; the page metadata dates publication to March 3, 2026.

sources.quote: Input price Free of charge $0.25 (text / image / video) $0.50 (audio) Output price (including thinking tokens) Free of charge $1.50
sources.supports: Google's pricing table lists Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite's standard paid input and output prices as $0.25 and $1.50 per million tokens.

sources.quote: March 3, 2026 Launched Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview, the first Flash-Lite model in the Gemini 3 series.
sources.supports: Google's changelog dates the preview launch to March 3, 2026.

notes: Google's March 3 launch announcement already states the same input and output prices models.dev later corrected to, so the earlier $0.50/$3.00 rate was not the provider's official price. Google's launch source does not establish cache_read pricing, and the current pricing page is not a dated historical record; no effective date for the models.dev correction is inferred.
